part.text:
Fixed. The `remote_ip` and `client_ip` Caddyfile matchers only consumed the first token segment, so when the same matcher was repeated (e.g. multiple `client_ip` lines inside a `not` block), all but the first list of IPs were silently discarded during config adaptation.

Changes in `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go`:
- `MatchRemoteIP.UnmarshalCaddyfile` (modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go:74) and `MatchClientIP.UnmarshalCaddyfile` (modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go:168) now wrap parsing in an outer `for d.Next()` loop so multiple matcher instances are concatenated/merged into one matcher with all ranges — matching the upstream fix.
- Removed dead module-lookup boilerplate from `MatchClientIP.UnmarshalCaddyfile`.

Validation: the previously failing adapt test (`caddytest/integration`, matcher_syntax) now passes with both IPs merged, and `go vet` plus `go test ./modules/caddyhttp/... ./caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/` all pass.
